decision.function: Header and body of the first notification form regarding paper invoice destruction results, containing form ID, official motto, recipient fields, introductory statement, invoice table, and signature blocks.
decision.interpretation: Bold, centered layout at the top of the first form; names the document type and directly introduces the addressee, data table, and signature blocks below.

decision.function: Header and body of the second report form regarding lost, burned, or damaged paper invoices, containing form ID, official motto, date, organizational details, introductory statement, and invoice table.
decision.interpretation: Bold, centered layout separating the two forms; names the second report type and directly introduces the organizational fields and table below.
